item.title: Croatia's goal was stolen! Portugal is scripted to advance
item.description: The feed for my Facebook reels is now full of videos analyzing the Croatian goal that wasn’t counted, and with conspiracy theories about the whole World Cup being scripted for a Ronaldo-Messi finale. And this is how easily social media radicalizes you. I have no idea how widespread either of these ideas are. Is there really a dominating public debate happening about this? I don’t think so. But for me, looking at my Facebook reels, it would appear like this is the most important thing happening right now.
